title: 第3章 闪金镇不是新手村吗第4章 我说你滑倒了你聋吗
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: 你妈的，这不是闪金镇吗？闪金镇不是新手村吗？新手村里为什么有这么可怕的东西？
在闪电熄灭后残留的视觉残影和重新降临的黑暗中，艾伦差点发出声音，但他忍住了。
虽然不知道对方是什么，但是敌不动，我不动。
黑暗中的等待令人煎熬，安静到艾伦能听见自己的心跳声。
不一会儿，又有闪电划过，房间被短暂照亮，只见刚刚像是六尊从雨夜湖底打捞上来排成一排雕像的孩子，此刻又走到一旁，变幻站成五芒星的阵型。
他们在干什么？进行仪式吗？
大脑疯狂运转的艾伦，突然听见旅馆门外传来一声尖利的惨叫声。
正在排列五芒星阵型的孩子们也朝声音的来源看去。
闪电过去，房间再次陷入黑暗，然而不一会儿，房门突然被猛地推开，温雷拎着油灯闯了进来。
看到温雷的那一刻，艾伦松了一口气，终于敢从床上起来。
你居然来了！温雷大叔、义父、爹！
“快往那照！”艾伦指向孩子们刚刚站的地方，温雷虽然不知道发生了什么，但毫不犹豫持灯走了过去。
然而，刚刚站了五芒星的角落，此刻却空无一人，只有地板上还留着湿漉漉的水渍。
“到底发生什么了？”温雷不解，他刚刚听见撕心裂肺的尖叫声，然后第一反应就是来看看“盟友”艾伦的安危。
“不知道，这间旅馆貌似有脏东西，我们出去看看。”艾伦光速穿上衣服，下了床点起灯。
两人下楼，只见旅馆的一楼，旅店老板愁眉不展地坐在那里喝酒，一边嘴里默念着，“又发生了，又是这样......”
“发生什么事了？？？”
旅店老板看到是贵客发问，便摸着自己的光头，无奈道：“我也不知道啊，这个月已经是第二起了，三周前，也是一个雷雨交加的夜晚，有个信差到这儿来过夜避雨，快到午夜十二点的时候，他一边尖叫着一边从楼上跑下来，最后他穿着睡衣逃进了瓢泼的大雨中，至今下落不明。”
灌了一口酒，他继续开口，“今天又是雨夜的时候我就感觉到不妙了，没想到居然又一次发生上次的怪事，你们楼下的一位住户，就在刚刚突然尖叫着从楼上跑下来，又一次冲进了大雨中，我怎么阻拦询问，他都不理会我。”
走到门前，老板指了指林间被闪电照亮时能勉强看清的黑影，“诺，就是他，已经跑了这么远，在这样下去，我的旅店就要倒闭关门了......”
温雷聚精会神地望了一会儿之后，开始披上披风，“你们在这等着，我去把他追回来。”
话音刚落，温雷便冲了出去。
“等等我啊，我也去！”
温雷不在，艾伦一下子少了安全感，本来也想追上去，但却被老板拦住，“普瑞斯托少爷，外面太危险了，你还是留在这比较好。”
回想起刚刚看到的那六个奇怪的小孩......艾伦觉得很难说哪里更安全......
“老板，你叫什么名字？”
艾伦想到一个办法，如果面前的旅店老板就是魔兽世界中狮王之傲的旅店老板，那么这里应该没有什么危险，因为直到游戏最新版本，旅店老板都还活得好好的。
“叫我法雷就好。”
额......艾伦突然发现自己压根就不知道狮王之傲的老板叫什么，他只知道炉石传说中的鲍勃。
还想看一眼温雷追到哪了，艾伦望门外一望，然后便陷入僵硬。
“法雷先生，你看......”
老板法雷顺着艾伦手指的方向一看，只见刚刚还是酒馆大门的地方，此刻却变成一面砖石筑成的红墙。

Damn it, isn’t this Goldshire? Isn’t Goldshire a novice village? Why are there such terrible things in Novice Village?
In the visual afterimage left after the lightning went out and the darkness that returned, Allen almost made a sound, but he held back.
Although I don’t know what the opponent is, I can’t move even if the enemy doesn’t move.
The waiting in the dark was excruciating, so quiet that Allen could hear his own heartbeat.
After a while, lightning flashed again, and the room was briefly illuminated. The six statues of children who had just been fished out from the bottom of the lake on a rainy night and lined up in a row were now walking to the side and changing into a five-pointed star formation.
What are they doing? Perform a ritual?
Allen, whose brain was running wildly, suddenly heard a sharp scream coming from outside the hotel door.
The children who were arranging the five-pointed star formation also looked towards the source of the sound.
The lightning passed and the room fell into darkness again. However, after a while, the door was suddenly pushed open and Wen Lei broke in with an oil lamp.
The moment he saw Wen Lei, Allen breathed a sigh of relief and finally dared to get up from the bed.
You're actually here! Uncle Wen Lei, foster father, father!
"Hurry up and take a photo there!" Allen pointed to the place where the children were standing just now. Although Wen Lei didn't know what happened, he walked over with the light without hesitation.
However, the corner where the five-pointed star had just been stood was empty at the moment, with only wet water stains still left on the floor.
"What happened?" Wen Lei was confused. He had just heard the heart-rending screams, and his first reaction was to check on the safety of his "ally" Allen.
"I don't know. There seems to be something dirty in this hotel. Let's go out and have a look." Alan put on his clothes at the speed of light, got out of bed and lit a lamp.
The two of them went downstairs and saw on the first floor of the hotel. The hotel owner was sitting there drinking with a frown on his face, muttering silently, "It happened again, it happened again..."
"What happened???"
When the innkeeper saw that it was an honored guest asking the question, he touched his bald head and said helplessly: "I don't know. It's the second time this month. Three weeks ago, it was also a thunderstorm night. A messenger came here to spend the night to take shelter from the rain. When it was almost midnight, he screamed and ran down the stairs. Finally, he escaped into the pouring rain in his pajamas. His whereabouts are still unknown."
After taking a sip of wine, he continued, "I felt something was wrong when it was a rainy night again today. I didn't expect that the strange thing happened last time. One of the residents downstairs just suddenly ran downstairs screaming and ran into the heavy rain again. No matter how I stopped and asked, he ignored me."
Walking to the door, the boss pointed to the dark figure in the forest that was illuminated by lightning and could barely be seen clearly, "No, that's him. He has run so far. If this continues, my hotel will close down..."
After Wen Lei looked attentively for a while, he began to put on his cloak and said, "You guys wait here, I will chase him back."
As soon as he finished speaking, Wen Lei rushed out.
"Wait for me, I'll go too!"
With Wen Lei away, Allen suddenly lost his sense of security. He originally wanted to catch up, but was stopped by his boss, "Master Presto, it's too dangerous outside. It's better for you to stay here."
Thinking back to the six strange children he just saw... Alan felt it was hard to say where was safer...
"Boss, what's your name?"
Allen thought of a way. If the innkeeper in front of him was the Lion's Pride innkeeper in World of Warcraft, then there should be no danger here, because until the latest version of the game, the innkeeper was still alive and well.
"Just call me Farley."
Um... Allen suddenly realized that he didn't know the name of the boss of Pride of the Lion at all. He only knew Bob in Hearthstone.
Wanting to see where Wen Lei had gone after him, Allen looked outside the door and then froze.
"Mr. Farley, look..."
Boss Farley looked in the direction of Allen's finger and saw that what was the door of the tavern just now had turned into a red wall made of bricks and stones.
